basis.basis_identity_rule: All five v49 direction arrays receive content hashes; the reconstructed straight-basis ledger, fifth-direction audit, anchors, and every scalar identity available in v47 must match v47. v47 did not publish direction-array hashes, so no retrospective hash-equality claim is allowed.

truth_constraints.field_limit: minimum of 1.01 times Direct-K4 field relative-L2 and Zero field relative-L2
truth_constraints.gradient_limit: minimum of 1.01 times Direct-K4 gradient relative-L2 and Zero gradient relative-L2
truth_constraints.normalized_margin_formula: For q in {field,gradient}, margin_q(w)=1-relative_squared_q(w)/(limit_q^2); a scored point is feasible only when all values are finite and min(margin_field,margin_gradient)>=-5e-8.

feasible_parameterization.map: For latent (d,r), find the largest retained lower endpoint t in [0,1] for which t*d has finite normalized margins and both margins are >=0, using 60 frozen bisection steps, then return w=r*t*d.
feasible_parameterization.convexity_reason: The box and both squared-norm truth constraints are convex and contain the origin, so the segment from zero to the retained radial endpoint is feasible.
feasible_parameterization.zero_direction_behavior: If L_inf(d)<=1e-15, return w=0 and t=1 without bisection.
feasible_parameterization.nonfinite_bisection_behavior: Any nonfinite latent coordinate or normalized margin is a fatal execution error and produces no objective score.
feasible_parameterization.endpoint_recheck: After bisection and after multiplying by r, recompute all margins; an endpoint outside the box or below -5e-8 is a fatal execution error and produces no exact forward.

deterministic_global_search.objective: exact curved-observation squared relative-L2 at the feasible mapped weight

deterministic_local_refinement.starts: the four global-search records with smallest exact objective after absolute-L_inf deduplication of their mapped weights; each retained record carries its original latent vector
deterministic_local_refinement.request_161_behavior: Reject before exact forward, record budget_exhausted=true, and force the overall stage-1 decision to inconclusive.

frozen_anchors: v43 feasible four-direction point with zero fifth weight
v44 selected weights radially mapped to feasibility
v47 best diagnostic candidate radially mapped to feasibility

members_in_request_order: all four frozen anchor exact-score requests
all local-refinement objective requests in start-index order
candidate_bank.deduplication: Scan the request ledger in order and retain the first row unless an earlier retained mapped weight has L_inf distance <=1e-10.
candidate_bank.local_start_order: Deduplicate global-search mapped weights with the same first-match rule, then sort by (objective, global_request_index, latent_lexicographic) and retain the first four.

per_snapshot: all field, gradient, and observation metrics are at most 1.01 times Direct-K4
all field, gradient, and observation metrics are no worse than Zero
observation is no worse than Direct-K3 plus 1e-12
candidate is not Pareto dominated by Direct-K3

stage_transition_and_decision_rule.stage_1_witness: at least one S2 candidate passes the complete frozen v40 gate after independent replay, with the global search and all four local executions valid, within budget, fully accounted, and deterministically replayed
stage_transition_and_decision_rule.stage_1_bounded_negative: no S2 candidate passes, the global search and all four local executions are valid and within budget, at least three of four local refinements report optimizer success, every objective request and candidate is accounted for, every exact-scored point and every derived metric or ratio is finite, nonnegative where applicable, and truth feasible, all frozen inputs, source files, and basis arrays match, and independent replay agrees
stage_transition_and_decision_rule.stage_1_inconclusive: input or basis parity, deterministic optimizer replay, request accounting, candidate completeness, finite/feasible checks, budget, minimum successful refinements, or independent replay fails
stage_transition_and_decision_rule.five_coefficient_learning_target_authori: all four snapshots independently contain at least one complete-gate witness under the same frozen search
stage_transition_and_decision_rule.stage_2_exact_reuse: For each of S1, S3, and S4 separately, repeat the same feasible map, PCG64 seed, 1664-request DE cap, four 160-request Powell caps, four anchors, request-order candidate roster, complete gate, input release checks, and independent replay. No snapshot may borrow candidates, starts, or budget from another snapshot.
stage_transition_and_decision_rule.five_space_engineering_route_closed: S2 reaches the bounded-negative decision; this stops further five-coefficient search and training but does not prove mathematical nonexistence
forbidden_rescue_actions: changing the objective after seeing results
